objective: All-question BCE on final logits for every group; no auxiliary objective or extra data
staging: Train independent first. Each staged run starts from same-seed selected independent checkpoint and unchanged train-only normalization. Base selected learning rate is fixed before later groups. Stage two has fresh AdamW, seed and data sampler. Finetune is continued independent training with the same additional search/step budget.
architecture: Frozen independent scorer b_i=head(h_i). Attention correction c=Transformer(h), delta=head_delta(c), zero-init final delta layer. residual_self allows each attention query only its own key; context reads all four. residual_context returns b+delta. residual_gated returns b+sigmoid(Linear([h,c]))*delta; gate starts at 0.1. residual_joint has same gated architecture but base parameters trainable. Independent and attention are exact prior architectures. No positional encoding.
freeze_policy: residual_self/context/gated: base parameters frozen AND base forced to eval in train mode; original scores must remain exactly equal to anchor. residual_joint permits base drift. Joint and finetune start from same anchor as frozen variants.
normalization: All training embeddings mean/std; same fixed 4x1024 inputs, no question features
checkpoint_selection: Official validation correct count, then lower validation BCE, then earlier epoch. Initial staged checkpoint (epoch0) eligible as fallback; never select a lower validation score than initialization. Patience starts at epoch0 for staged runs. From-scratch groups retain previous baseline selection behavior.
learning_rate_selection: Seed17: official validation correct count then lower validation BCE; exact ties first LR. Remaining four seeds use chosen LR.
final_selection: Highest five-seed mean official validation accuracy, ties lower parameters then protocol order. Export fixed seed17 single model; no ensemble.
diagnostics: Eval-mode train/validation loss and accuracy; official base-only ablation at selected checkpoint; corrections versus pretrained anchor and versus current base; saved base, raw delta, gate and final logits. Repair/harm counts are diagnostics, not extra selected models. Gate values are not calibrated confidence or uniquely identifiable contribution measures.
uncertainty: Five paired seeds; 10000 paired question bootstrap draws over seed-mean correctness, conditional exploratory intervals, reused validation set, no multiple-comparison correction. Report non-search-seed mean.
cost_policy: 42 actual training runs (7 groups x 6), 35 selected. Stage costs and required independent pretraining reported separately; shared anchors not charged repeatedly in total compute. Self-mask is stored-parameter matched but Q/K have no effective matching role with one key.
test_policy: No test training, selection, predictions or scores; checker can verify test integrity only
